name: Southwestern Chicken Salad
desc: Shredded chicken in a lime and cumin Greek yogurt dressing with black beans, corn, bell pepper and cilantro.

source.title: Southwestern Chicken Salad
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp kosher salt and a few grinds black pepper, for poaching
ingredients.note: plus a few grinds black pepper

ingredients.raw: 1 cup full-fat plain Greek yogurt or skyr
ingredients.item: full-fat plain Greek yogurt or skyr

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste
3/4 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup red bell pepper, finely diced
1/2 cup fire-roasted corn, thawed if frozen

steps: Put the chicken in a medium pot, season with the salt and pepper, and cover by at least 1 in with water. Bring to a boil, then cover, lower the heat, and simmer 15-20 min until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Shred the chicken in a stand mixer on low or with two forks.
In a large bowl, whisk the yogurt, lime juice, cumin, chili powder and smoked paprika. Add the chicken and all the mix-ins and stir. Season with salt, pepper and cayenne.
Chill at least 30 min, until cold and the flavors meld. Serve on whole wheat toast, with tortilla chips, on a rice cake, or in a wrap.
tips: 2 1/2 cups rotisserie chicken can replace the poached chicken. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
Optional add-ins: cotija, jalapeño, avocado, tomato.
